description: §22.4.1 (S459 round 4 F2) — a control inside an emitted `<form>` named like a form member (`action`) would shadow `form.action`. E-META-EVAL-002.
rationale: §22.12 *Named properties*: a control's `id` / `name` inside a form, against the members of HTMLFormElement; §22.4.1 makes it `E-META-EVAL-002`. (S459 round 4, PA decisions on the S459 final review — bryan "go")
